Mortal Shell 2 REVIEW - The BEST SOULSLIKE of ALL TIME ???
In this video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions with Mortal Shell 2. I finished the game earlier this week. Absolutely had a ton of fun playing this game. It was one of those games that I played that I really didn't want to stop playing once I started playing. Those games these days are few and far between, so I really, really enjoyed it.
